shops.description: Wok & Flame is a fast food restaurant in Port Vila, Vanuatu. Typical items include French Fries, Fried Chicken Drumsticks, Roasted Chicken, Whole Roasted Chicken, Sizzling Beef Steak, Chicken Hamburger, Beef Hamburger, Hot Dog, Sandwich, Italian Pasta, Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, beer, and wine. Receipt language is usually English and currency is Vatu (VT/VUV). Use these names only as hints when OCR text is unclear; visible receipt text always wins.
